name: IBY_TEMP_EXT_BANK_ACCTS
description: IBY_TEMP_EXT_BANK_ACCTS defines the temporary records for external bank accounts.

columns.name: TEMP_EXT_BANK_ACCT_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Populated by Oracle.

columns.name: EXT_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Bank account identifier. Use the Manage Bank Accounts task to identify valid values.

columns.name: PAYMENT_FLOW
columns.description: Specifies funds capture or disbursement flow. Use the Manage Lookup Types task, lookup type IBY_PAYMENT_FLOW to identify valid values.

columns.name: COUNTRY_CODE
columns.description: Country code where the bank is located. Use the two character ISO code. Example: United States is US.

columns.name: BRANCH_ID
columns.description: Identifies bank branch. Used if BANK_ID is populated. Use the Manage Bank Branches task to identify valid values.

columns.name: BANK_ID
columns.description: Identifies branch''s bank. Mandatory if Allow International Payments, FOREIGN_PAYMENT_USE_FLAG is Y. Use the Manage Bank Accounts task to identify valid values.

columns.name: BANK_NAME
columns.description: Bank name. Must be unique based on the country code.

columns.name: BANK_NUMBER
columns.description: Bank number. The combination of bank number, branch number, and country code must be unique for each bank.

columns.name: BANK_NAME_ALT
columns.description: Alternative bank name. Free text field. Not validated.

columns.name: BANK_INSTITUTION_TYPE
columns.description: Bank institution type. Valid values: BANK, CLEARINGHOUSE.

columns.name: BANK_ADDRESS_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: BRANCH_NUMBER
columns.description: Branch number assigned by banking authority. For US banks, use the nine-digit transit routing number. The number must be unique for the bank.

columns.name: BRANCH_TYPE
columns.description: Branch type. Valid values: BANK_BRANCH, CLEARINGHOUSE_BRANCH.

columns.name: BRANCH_NAME
columns.description: Branch name. Free text field. Not validated.

columns.name: BRANCH_NAME_ALT
columns.description: Alternative branch name. Free text field. Not validated.

columns.name: BIC
columns.description: Bank Identifier Code (BIC) for the payee bank branch. First four letters are institution or bank code. Position four through six are country code. Positions six through eight are location code. Last three characters are optional: bank code.

columns.name: RFC_IDENTIFIER
columns.description: Branch Regional Finance Center. Applicable to US banks only. Use the Manage Cash Management Lookups task, lookup type RFC_IDENTIFIER to identify valid values.

columns.name: BANK_CODE
columns.description: Short code for the bank. Varies based upon country of bank branch. Use the Manage Cash Management Lookups task, lookup type BANK_CODE to identify valid values by country.

columns.name: BRANCH_ADDRESS_ID
columns.description: Branch location. Oracle internal use only. Foreign key to HZ_IMP_LOCATIONS_T.LOCATION_T_ID.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_OWNER_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Owner party Identifier.

columns.name: OWNER_PRIMARY_FLAG
columns.description: Primary flag for the owner. Use: Y. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME
columns.description: Bank account name. Free text field. Not validated.

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM
columns.description: Account number. The combination of bank account number, branch number, country code, and currency must be unique for each bank.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code. Use the Manage Currencies task to find valid values. Use the three character ISO currency code. Example: US Dollars is USD. Leave this field blank if the bank account accepts payments in multiple currencies.

columns.name: IBAN
columns.description: International Bank Account Number (IBAN) for the payee bank account.  First two positions are letters. Third and fourth positions are numbers. Mod 97 rule is used for IBAN check digit.

columns.name: CHECK_DIGITS
columns.description: Check digits to validate bank account number.

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME_ALT
columns.description: Alternate account name. Free text field. Not validated.

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_TYPE
columns.description: Bank account type. Valid values: SAVINGS, CHECKING, OTHER. Use the Manage Standard Lookups task, lookup IBY_BANKACCT_TYPES to identify valid values.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_SUFFIX
columns.description: Account suffix. New Zealand banks only: combination of bank account number, currency, and account suffix must be unique within a bank.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description. Free text field. Not validated.

columns.name: AGENCY_LOCATION_CODE
columns.description: Agency location code assigned by the treasury financial management service of the company. Free text field. Not validated.

columns.name: PAYMENT_FACTOR_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this is a payment factor bank account. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: FOREIGN_PAYMENT_USE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether foreign payments are permitted: when the bank branch country of payer bank account differs from payee bank account country. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_AGREEMENT_NUM
columns.description: Exchange rate agreement number. Free text field. Not validated.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_AGREEMENT_TYPE
columns.description: Exchange rate agreement type. Use the Manage Standard Lookups task, lookup type IBY_XCHG_RATE_AGREEMENT to identify valid values.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: Exchange rate per agreement between supplier and its bank account. Used to convert payment currency to bank account currency.

columns.name: HEDGING_CONTRACT_REFERENCE
columns.description: Hedging contract reference. Free text field. Not validated.

columns.name: SECONDARY_ACCOUNT_REFERENCE
columns.description: Additional account number reference. Example: Building Society Roll Number. Free text field. Not validated.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Date when the bank account becomes active. Date format: YYYY/MM/DD. Must be earlier than END_DATE.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Date when the bank account becomes inactive. Date format: YYYY/MM/DD. Must be later than START_DATE.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY
columns.description: Context code for External Bank Accounts descriptive flexfield. Use the Manage Payment System Connectivity Flexfields task to identify valid values. Use ATTRIBUTE1 to ATTRIBUTE15 for the segment values.

columns.name: NOTE
columns.description: Note. Free text field.

columns.name: NOTE_ALT
columns.description: Alternative note. Free text field. Not validated.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE1
columns.description: Segment value for External Bank Accounts descriptive flexfield.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of the bank account approval process.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PROGRAM_APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Who column.

columns.name: PROGRAM_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Who column.

columns.name: PROGRAM_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Who column.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. Incremented every time the row is updated. Compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CALLING_APP_UNIQUE_REF1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. First unique identifier of the owner in the source product.

columns.name: CALLING_APP_UNIQUE_REF2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Second unique identifier of the owner in the source product

columns.name: EXT_PAYEE_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Payee to whom the bank account must be assigned. Not used for Oracle Cloud implementations.

columns.name: FEEDER_IMPORT_BATCH_ID
columns.description: Batch identifier.  Must be unique.

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM
columns.description: Original system for the bank account. Not used for Oracle Cloud implementations. Free text field. Not validated.

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE
columns.description: Original system reference for the bank account. Not used for Oracle Cloud implementations. Free text field. Not validated.

columns.name: BANK_MRG_TGT_OSR
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Stores the original source reference of the bank merge target interface record.

columns.name: BRANCH_MRG_TGT_OSR
columns.description: Stores the original source reference of the branch merge target interface record.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: request ID of the loader job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: TEMP_EXT_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Account owner party identifier. Use either ACCOUNT_OWNER_PARTY_ID  or TEMP_EXT_PARTY_ID, but not both.

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM_ELECTRONIC
columns.description: The bank account number used in electronic files, if different from the written form.

columns.name: BA_NUM_ELEC_SEC_SEGMENT_ID
columns.description: Electronically-formatted bank number security segment identifier.

columns.name: SALT_VERSION
columns.description: Denotes the versions of the encryption algorithm used for the bank account number encryption.

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Enterprise identifier to support multi-tenancy.

columns.name: ENCRYPTED_FLAG
columns.description: Whether the instrument is encrypted.

columns.name: IBAN_SEC_SEGMENT_ID
columns.description: Security identifier of IBAN(International Bank Account Number).

columns.name: IBAN_HASH1
columns.description: Hash value of IBAN(International Bank Account Number).

columns.name: IBAN_HASH2
columns.description: Salted hash value of IBAN(International Bank Account Number).

columns.name: MASKED_IBAN
columns.description: Masked IBAN value to be used for display purposes.

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM_HASH1
columns.description: Hash of the bank account number.

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM_HASH2
columns.description: Hash of the salted bank account number.

columns.name: MASKED_BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM
columns.description: Masked bank account number to be used for display purposes.

columns.name: BA_MASK_SETTING
columns.description: Current bank account masking setting values taken from lookup IBY_INSTRUMENT_MASK_SETTING.

columns.name: BA_UNMASK_LENGTH
columns.description: Number of digits to expose in the external bank account mask.

columns.name: BA_NUM_SEC_SEGMENT_ID
columns.description: Bank account number security identifier.
